summary: Iterates 104 byte elements of the this array, applying SaturatedByteAdd(&this[i], a2) to each and keeping the last result as the return value. Only known caller is FloatFractionFromInt (0x00464EF0).

operations.description: Loop i from 0 to 103, exactly 104 iterations over the byte array this.
Call SaturatedByteAdd(&this[i], a2) for each element and store the result.
Return the result of the last SaturatedByteAdd call.

unresolved: Whether this is a 104-entry array of independent per-element flags or a packed byte block is unknown; 104 matches the engine's vehicle slot count but no packet evidence links them.
Saturation semantics and exact byte type produced by SaturatedByteAdd (0x00464A10) live in that callee.
